name: ai-task-board-bridge
description: Unified interactive installer and device bridge for Codex, Kimi Code, Antigravity, and Claude Code on AI Task Board

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ai-task-board/kimi-bridge-runtime && npm run build --workspace @ai-task-board/antigravity-bridge-runtime && npm run build --workspace @ai-task-board/claude-code-bridge-runtime && node scripts/embed-runtimes.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755)"
